incident-bot: Pager: INC-2026-0423 — embedder latency spike + increased 5xx rate for /v1/embeddings. Triggered at 22:14 UTC. Affected: Tier 2 customers in us-west.
Maya (oncall): Saw alerts — spikes ~18m, 12% error rate at peak. Rolling rollback to previous embedder build in progress. :rotating_light:
Priya (eng-sre): Thanks Maya. Can you confirm whether the KV eviction baseline changed? I saw elevated eviction rate around 22:10.
Maya (oncall): Yes eviction count jumped right before spike. Rolling change rolled back at 22:20. Error rate trending down now.
Ryan (eng-runtime): Quick note — deploy included a runtime tweak to aggressive KV pruning for memory savings. Might be correlated.
Sam (eng-ml): Add: embedder model cache miss rate also rose; looks like short-term cache churn.
Luis (product): Any customer-facing impact? Do we need to notify major accounts/support?
Maya (oncall): CS notified Affected-Customers channel. No major data loss, latency/error visible in dashboards only. Support docs updated.
Priya (eng-sre): Proposed post-incident: schedule 60m postmortem tomorrow, owner + three action items: triage root cause, revert hardening for KV policy, add longer-term mitigations.
Ryan (eng-runtime): I can own runtime triage. Initial estimate: 1 engineer * 3 days to root cause + patch (includes perf tests). Short-term rollback already done.
Sam (eng-ml): I'll handle embedder cache metrics and tests. Estimate 1d to add regression tests + 2d to add cache resilience logic.
Luis (product): Prioritization: Severity = Sev2 customer-visible latency. Recommend we slot the main remediation into next sprint as 'P1-sprint' and the deeper resilience work into Q2 roadmap.
Priya (eng-sre): Action-item list (brief): 1) RC1: runtime KV policy revert confirmation — owner Ryan — size: 0.5d. 2) RC2: add eviction safety gate/thresholds + canary — owner Priya — size: 2d. 3) RC3: add embedder cache regression tests and monitor — owner Sam — size: 3d. 4) Ops: customer comms follow-up — owner Luis — size: 0.25d.
Maya (oncall): Let's capture these in the remediation tracker. Also add an immediate alert tweak: alert on eviction-rate delta > 3x for 5m — owner Priya — 0.5d.
Ryan (eng-runtime): Agreed. I'll post links to the deploy that introduced the change and the rollback in the thread after this.
Sam (eng-ml): For sizing granularity, prefer: small (<=1d), medium (1-3d), large (>3d). So RC1 small, RC2 medium, RC3 large.
Luis (product): Tie to quarterly planning: RC2 (eviction safety) = Q2 candidate, RC3 (resilience tests) = Q2-Q3 continuous improvement. RC1 and alert tweaks are hotfixes — ship this sprint.
Priya (eng-sre): Postmortem scheduling: propose Wed 10:00 PT (60m). Maya can we confirm availability? Need owner reps from eng-runtime, eng-ml, and product.
Maya (oncall): I'm free Wed 10:00 PT. Pinged Ryan, Sam, Luis — they flagged tentative OK.
Ryan (eng-runtime): Confirmed.
Sam (eng-ml): Confirmed.
Luis (product): Confirmed.
Maya (oncall): Great — I'll create the postmortem doc and link action items to remediation tracker. Quick template note: include timeline, root cause hypothesis, impact quant, and owner+ETA for each action.
Priya (eng-sre): Also add a follow-up checkpoint 2 weeks after patch to verify rollback efficacy and alert thresholds.
Luis (product): I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and summary for execs if needed. Low-friction note: no SLA breach expected but we'll mention incident and mitigation.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (rollback applied). Postmortem scheduled: 2212432078 (Wed 10:00 PT). Remediation items added to tracker.
Maya (oncall): Thanks team. I'll add a short incident note in #incidents-summary after the postmortem doc is ready. :white_check_mark:
